title: A bite: one idea, one picture

Tax codes1 / 3
The code is two parts
1257L
Tax-free payadd a 0: £12,570The letterL = the standard one
The number is how much you can earn tax-free, without the last zero. The letter tells your employer which rules apply to you.

title: Tell it back to life
html:

Your turn0:41
Tell me what a tax code is, like I’ve never heard of one.
It’s like… the number is how much you earn before tax kicks in, so 1257 is about twelve and a half grand. And the letter is the type.
Oh nice. So why would the letter matter if the number’s the same?
Because M1 means they’re guessing, so you can end up paying too much…
